independentReview.reviewerNote:
The reviewer is Codex in a read-only role and authored none of the delta. It supersedes the REQUIRE CHANGES review at b030c91a (https://github.com/Pootytxng/sentinel/pull/550#issuecomment-5804229826), whose two blocking findings (FIFO mutex admission, and the 10s-versus-6s fixed-pause margin) the review-repair commit d119fe0c addresses. Its checks:
- The guard no longer assumes FIFO admission and no longer uses fixed parent-side pauses or wall-clock hold assertions as the behavioral proof; it takes whichever queued lane Windows admits and paces handoffs from the contenders' own queue notices, keeping waitFor only as a hang guard.
- A readable holder-key change restarts the deadline, a missing note is a known transition, and an unreadable note stays unknown and does not reset it.
- The stuck-holder case still times out and names the holder.
- It ran `npx vitest run scripts/gate-mutex-guard.test.mjs` itself at this exact head: 1 file, 12/12 passed in 36.59s.
- The production change stays bounded to scripts/lib/gate-mutex.ps1 and the guard to scripts/gate-mutex-guard.test.mjs.

The author session separately falsified the repaired case against the pre-fix library (blob b417efef): the waiter gave up after 20s behind the second holder and the test failed on its exit code, not on the hang guard. With the fix (blob 61de02d8) it passed 4 of 4 focused runs.

The shared Pootytxng account records the verdict as a PR comment whose body names the reviewer role.
